system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> Why send me an email saying I can get premium for $99/yr then when i go to do so, you tell me I am not eligible .. Not fair Spotify.. Not Fair!"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey there! We're launching regularly in countries around the world. Be sure to add your email at <URL>"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address eligibility or apologize for confusion; lacks clarity and helpful info."}
